x-enum-exempt: OAuth scope tokens carried in issued access tokens
description: OAuth 2.0 scope values that can be requested by clients. Delegated REST scopes bound operations before the owning service evaluates resource policy. A scope is an upper bound, not a resource permission or an automatic Cedar grant. Each scope follows the pattern "resource:action" where resource indicates the resource type and action indicates the permitted operation (read, write, send, trigger).
